title: Project Initialization
description: Developer initialises a new project via 'composer init' or 'composer create-project', generating composer.json and bootstrapping the Composer instance.
use_cases: Provide package metadata (name, description, author, type, license)
use_case_actors_map: Run composer init ..> Provide package metadata (include)
Run composer init ..> Add require / require-dev dependencies (include)
Run composer init ..> Confirm composer.json generation (extend, interactive only)
Run composer init ..> Add vendor to .gitignore (extend, interactive + git present)
Run composer init ..> Install project dependencies (extend, interactive + has deps)
Run composer create-project ..> Bootstrap Composer instance (include)
Run composer create-project ..> Install root package from VCS/dist (extend, when packageName given)
Run composer create-project ..> Install project dependencies (extend, unless --no-install)
Run composer create-project ..> Run post-install scripts (include)
Run composer create-project ..> Add custom repositories (extend, --add-repository)
key_relationships: Installer depends_on Config, Package (RootPackageInterface), RepositoryManager, Locker, EventDispatcher
Config stores project/global settings (preferred-install, optimize-autoloader, etc.)
Package (extends BasePackage) represents a versioned package: name, version, prettyVersion
interaction_flow: Installer → Installer: run() — resolves + installs dependencies

InitCommand.configure: setName('init'), options: name, description, author, type, homepage, require, require-dev, stability, license, repository, autoload
InitCommand.initialize: initialize(InputInterface, OutputInterface): void — sets default name/author in non-interactive mode

CreateProjectCommand.configure: setName('create-project'), args: package, directory, version; options: stability, prefer-source, prefer-dist, repository, no-install, no-audit, no-scripts, keep-vcs, add-repository, require, ...
CreateProjectCommand.execute: execute(InputInterface, OutputInterface): int — delegates to installProject()
CreateProjectCommand.installProject: installProject(IOInterface, Config, InputInterface, packageName, directory, packageVersion, stability, preferSource, preferDist, installDevPackages, repositories, ...): int

BaseCommand.createComposerInstance: createComposerInstance(InputInterface, IOInterface, config, ?disablePlugins, ?disableScripts): Composer — calls Factory::create()
BaseCommand.initialize: initialize(InputInterface, OutputInterface): void — fires PreCommandRunEvent via EventDispatcher

Installer.run: run(): int — full dependency resolution and installation
Installer.constructor: __construct(IOInterface, Config, RootPackageInterface, DownloadManager, RepositoryManager, Locker, InstallationManager, EventDispatcher, AutoloadGenerator)

important_notes: InitCommand is interactive by default — prompts for all fields; non-interactive mode uses --option flags directly.
JsonFile::validateSchema(LAX_SCHEMA) is called after write; on failure composer.json is deleted and exit code 1 returned.
CreateProjectCommand::installProject handles two main paths: (1) package name given → installRootPackage + Installer.run(); (2) no package name → install existing composer.json via Installer.
Installer::create() is a static factory that wires all dependencies from the Composer instance.
Config::get() is the single read point for all config values (preferred-install, optimize-autoloader, apcu-autoloader, etc.).
POST_ROOT_PACKAGE_INSTALL and POST_CREATE_PROJECT_CMD script events fired by EventDispatcher during create-project.
BaseCommand::initialize fires PreCommandRunEvent via EventDispatcher before every command runs.
